s.g: To ignore deliberately.
Immunoglobulin G.
To ignore (a user on a chat system, etc.).
The ignore function of such a chat system.
ex: Sniper, I'm putting you on iggy until you stop posting all those song lyrics.

s.g: Synonym of Italian greyhound.
A dome-shaped Inuit shelter, constructed of blocks cut from snow.
A cavity, or excavation, made in the snow by a seal, over its breathing hole in the sea ice.
A reinforced bunker for the storage of nuclear weapons.
A kind of airfreight cargo container.
Pertaining to or having the nature of fire; containing fire; resembling fire.
ex: The stone had an igneous appearance.

s.g: Resulting from, or produced by, great heat. With rocks, it could also mean formed from lava or magma.
ex: Granite and basalt are igneous rocks.

tt: Igneous rocks form when lava cools.

s.g: One of the major groups of rock that makes up the crust of the Earth; formed by the cooling of molten rock, either below the surface (intrusive) or on the surface (extrusive).
To set fire to (something), to light (something)
To spark off (something), to trigger
To commence burning.
To subject to the action of intense heat; to heat strongly; often said of incombustible or infusible substances.
The act of igniting.
The initiation of combustion.
A system for activating combustion in a combustion engine.
Receptacle for a key used to start the engine in a vehicle.
ex: Put the key in the ignition and turn in right.

s.g: Able to be ignored.
ex: Users on this Internet chat system are ignorable by right-clicking the user name.

s.g: Insignificant or trivial enough to be ignored.
Unrelated to the parameters being estimated
A totally ignorant person—unknowledgeable, uneducated, or uninformed; a fool.
A grand jury's ruling on an indictment when the evidence is determined to be insufficient to send the case to trial.
To make such a ruling against (an indictment).
The condition of being uninformed or uneducated; lack of knowledge or information.
ex: She shows total ignorance about the topic at hand.

s.g: Sins committed through ignorance.
Existential blindness.
A lack of knowledge or awareness about certain facts or situations results in happiness or reduced anxiety.
Unknowledgeable or uneducated; characterized by ignorance.
Not knowing (a fact or facts), unaware (of something).
Ill-mannered, crude.
ex: His manner was at best off-hand, at worst totally ignorant.

s.g: Resulting from ignorance; foolish; silly.
One who is ignorant.

tt: Ignorant people tend to be arrogant.

s.g: To deliberately not listen or pay attention to.
ex: A problem ignored is a problem doubled.

s.g: To pretend to not notice someone or something.
The act by which something is ignored.
A stock character, the lab assistant to a mad scientist, vampire, or miser frequently depicted as being deformed in some manner, physically and/or psychologically.
A green iguana (Iguana iguana), a large tropical American lizard often kept as a pet.
Any member of the genus Iguana.
In America and the Pacific, any of several members of the lizard family Iguanidae.
In Africa, any large member of the genus Varanus, especially the aquatic Nile monitor (see leguan).
